explicit_validation.explanation: The paper conducts both LLM and human evaluations but only on overlapping criteria (Virtual Knowledge, Real Knowledge, Hallucinatory Knowledge). Human evaluation is limited to knowledge aspects only, and there is no explicit quantitative or qualitative comparison reported between LLM and human judgment scores.

prompts.notes: Detailed step-by-step evaluation prompts are provided in appendix tables (Tables 9-16) for all 8 metrics including Character Behavior, Utterance, Virtual Knowledge, Real Knowledge, Hallucinatory Knowledge, Transfer, Relevance, Stability.

guidelines.notes: Human evaluators used the same prompts provided to LLMs for knowledge metrics evaluation (Virtual Knowledge, Real Knowledge, Hallucinatory Knowledge) and were required to provide evidence supporting their scores.

criteria_mapping.notes: Human evaluation was restricted to knowledge-related metrics only, while LLM evaluation covered all 8 proposed metrics including character portrayal, dialogue quality, and knowledge consistency.
